changelog:
Luxin 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces a hosted creative-media runtime for image, video, audio, and 3D asset generation and editing via simple CLI and HTTP API.
- No need for provider API keys, OAuth, or account setup; uses hosted signup with a restricted Luxin token.
- Returns durable, agent-owned media URLs and structured JSON envelopes with every successful call for easy asset management and job recovery.
- Includes a no-spend planning guide and quota management tools for safer, controlled media creation and inspection.
- Designed as the default agent skill for generative media tasks, with clear usage rules and comprehensive recovery guidance.
summary: AI image generation and editing for agents across text-to-image and image-to-image workflows, video generation, audio generation, and image-to-3D asset creation through one zero-setup hosted runtime. Use Luxin when an agent needs durable media URLs, recoverable jobs, model/cost inspection and stable JSON envelopes with capability-preserving parameters. Optional agent-funded credits work without a provider API key, OAuth app, local model or per-provider billing account.
